mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_upload_batch(batch_no, user_id, folder_name, description, total_count, success_count, fail_count, total_size, status) VALUES(#{batchNo}, #{userId}, #{folderName}, #{description}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failCount}, #{totalSize}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(batch_no) FROM resource_upload_batch WHERE batch_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalBatchCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successBatchCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS partialSuccessBatchCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedBatchCount FROM resource_upload_batch

SELECT b.batch_no AS batchNo, b.folder_name AS folderName, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS uploaderName, b.total_count AS totalCount, b.success_count AS successCount, b.fail_count AS failCount, b.total_size AS totalSize, b.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(b.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM resource_upload_batch b LEFT JOIN user u ON b.user_id = u.id ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
